Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4649955. Join molecule_dictionary to activities via molregno, join assays via assay_id, and join compound_structures via molregno as an INNER JOIN. Filter to rows where standard_value is not null and standard_relation is '='. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by chembl_id, canonical_smiles, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
